annotation.bound_parties_text: All personal delivery devices and their operators must comply with the rules (obey traffic control devices, carry identification, have brakes, be actively controlled or monitored by the operator), while counties, municipalities and highway districts may adopt regulations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: No personal delivery device shall operate on a sidewalk or crosswalk unless the personal delivery device operator is actively controlling or monitoring the navigation and operation of the personal delivery device.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: AN ACT RELATING TO PERSONAL DELIVERY DEVICES; AMENDING SECTION 49-117, IDAHO CODE, TO DEFINE "PERSONAL DELIVERY DEVICE"
